name: Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Project & Portfolio Management (PPM), covering portfolio demand intake, business case evaluation, project chartering, WBS task scheduling, resource allocation, risk/issue management, change control, and benefits realization.
owner: Global Enterprise PMO & Portfolio Governance Office

checklists.name: Project & Portfolio Management Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for portfolio prioritization, project chartering, RAID log tracking, and change control.

items.statement: Portfolio proposals undergo business case evaluation (NPV, ROI, strategic alignment) prior to funding allocation.
Project Charter defines clear scope boundaries, key deliverables, milestones, and executive sponsor sign-off.
Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) identifies task dependencies and critical path milestones.
RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) is updated weekly with mitigation strategies.
Scope or budget variances exceeding 5% require formal Change Request (CR) PMO approval.

reviewGates.name: Enterprise PMO Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The PMO Director confirms that project charters, milestone schedules, and RAID risk mitigations comply with PPM standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the PPM documentation confirm project plan feasibility and risk mitigation effectiveness?
